name: schema
summary: The API server would reject the policy: it fails the CustomResourceDefinition's schema.

name: duplicate-item
summary: A method, path, host or selector glob is listed twice; the API server rejects the policy.

name: compile
summary: The compiler rejects the policy: it allows nothing, and still claims its hosts for the actors it selects.

name: audit-shadowed
summary: An Audit policy never has effect on a host: an Enforce policy claims the host for every actor it selects.

name: audit-partly-shadowed
summary: An Audit policy has no effect on a host for some of its actors: an Enforce policy claims the host for them too.

name: audit-maybe-shadowed
summary: An Audit policy may have no effect on a host: an Enforce policy claims it, and their selectors may overlap.

name: redundant-path
summary: A path template allows nothing that another template of the same policy and host does not already allow.

name: overlapping-routes
summary: Two routes of a policy allow the same paths for some of the same methods.

name: tls-passthrough
summary: A claimed host is on a tls_passthrough rule of the given EgressPolicy, so ate-gress never sees that traffic.

name: host-not-reached
summary: No http or https rule of the given EgressPolicy reaches a claimed host, so the claim has no effect for that actor.
